For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Kuurne.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.Your responsibilities: 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry in Zottegem, is currently looking for a motivated operator to join the packaging department in a 2 shift system.What will your responsibilities be?As a packaging operator, you are an essential link in our client’s production process.Multitasking, precision and working at a fast pace are your strengths.Your responsibilities: 
• You will mainly be responsible for packaging the finished products. 
• You will regularly carry out quality checks. 
• You will ensure that packaging materials are supplied to the production line. 
• You will set up your machine and keep it running smoothly. 
• Labelling and logistical tasks will also be part of your responsibilities. 
• Finally, you will ensure a clean and tidy working environment.The working hours are from Monday till Friday in a 2 shiftsystem:early shift: 06:00–14:00late shift: 14:00–22:00
 
• You have some previous experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry. 
• You are available to start soon. 
• You speak Dutch and/or English fluently. 
• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job in 2 shifts. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

• Coordinate and oversee all aspects of maritime transportation operations, including vessel scheduling, cargo handling, and port logistics. 
• Liaise with shipping carriers, freight forwarders, and customs authorities to ensure timely and cost-effective cargo movement. 
• Maintain accurate records of cargo shipments, documentation, and tracking information.

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description
Your responsibilities
• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.
Your profile
• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong presence in Brussels. They are currently seeking an experienced Management Assistant to provide high-level administrative and organisational support to a team of lawyers within a fast-paced and demanding environment.

Jobomschrijving

As a Management Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the legal team by providing comprehensive administrative support.Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing complex calendars and coordinating meetings.
• Organising domestic and international travel arrangements.
• Assisting with client onboarding and matter opening processes.
• Supporting billing and expense management activities.
• Drafting, proofreading, formatting and finalising legal documents and correspondence.
• Managing document filing and record-keeping systems.
• Handling incoming calls, emails, and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and related services, including catering and IT support.
• Liaising with internal departments and external stakeholders.
• Ensuring a high level of confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
• Providing general administrative support and assisting with ad hoc projects.

• Strong previous experience as a Management Assistant, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
• Excellent organisational and multitasking skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
• Experience with document management systems is an advantage.
• Fluent English, together with French and/or Dutch.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Professional, proactive and service-oriented mindset.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Flexible and adaptable approach in a fast-paced environment.

Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
• Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
• Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
• Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

Our client is a globally recognised industrial organisation with a strong reputation for innovation, operational excellence and customer-centricity. With an international footprint and a collaborative culture, the company invests heavily in employee development and continuous learning.Employees benefit from a dynamic working environment where knowledge sharing, professional growth and teamwork are highly valued, creating opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

Jobomschrijving

• Partner with management to identify training needs and develop tailored learning solutions.
• Design, create and continuously improve training materials, manuals, guides and digital learning content.
• Deliver engaging training sessions for both new hires and existing employees.
• Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements where needed.
• Maintain training records and monitor employee learning progress.
• Provide individual coaching and ongoing support to customer service professionals.
• Support the implementation of learning and development initiatives across the organisation.
• Research and introduce modern training methodologies and best practices.
• Contribute to various projects related to employee development and organisational learning.

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.Functieomschrijving 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 
• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 
• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 
• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

Our client is an international company headquartered in Beveren, with an annual turnover of more than €12 million. The company is part of a larger international group and combines stability with growth.To strengthen its finance team, they are looking for an experienced GL Accountant who wants to contribute to further professionalisation and efficient reporting within a dynamic working environment.Functieomschrijving 
• Responsible for the full accounting cycle (from A to Z) for multiple entities. 
• Carrying out monthly and annual closing procedures. 
• Preparing financial reports. 
• Reviewing and monitoring general ledger and analytical accounting. 
• Handling intercompany reconciliations and account reconciliations. 
• Filing Belgian VAT returns, corporate income tax returns and annual financial statements. 
• Contributing to ad hoc projects and process optimisation.In addition, you will report directly to the Group Finance Manager.
Bachelor or Master degree in Accounting, with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.Strong communication skills.English is a must-have, Dutch is a nice-to-have.Proactive and willing to take initiative and responsibility, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

Our client is a prestigious law firm based in Brussels. Offices are reachable by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

As a German-speaking Partner Secretary, your responsibilities are:

• Manage the Partner's agenda and coordinate meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements
• Handle correspondence, emails, and phone calls in German and English
• Prepare and format legal documents, presentations, and reports
• Organize and maintain digital and physical filing systems
• Liaise with clients and internal departments in a professional and confidential manner
• Assist with billing and time entry
• Support in the organization of events and internal meetings

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar role, ideally within a law firm or professional services environment
• You speak German with an excellent command of English (spoken and written); French is a plus
• Strong organizational and communication skills
• Proficient in MS Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel)
• Discreet, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure with a high level of professionalism
